title: Login button fails to appear in the home page for first launch after refresh it appear
steps: 1. Launch the application for the first time after a refresh. 2. Observe that the login button is not visible. 3. Refresh the page. 4. The login button should now be visible.
expected: The login button should be visible on the first launch after a refresh.
actual: The login button is not visible on the first launch after a refresh.
